levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The report omits one or more of the three parts (what happened, what's being done, what's needed), or spends most of its time on excuses.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The report includes all three parts clearly.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The report is concise and owns the mistake directly, without over-apologizing or under-explaining.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The revised version is nearly identical to the first attempt despite feedback being given.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The revised version reflects specific feedback that was given.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The learner can articulate why the revision is an improvement, not just that a change was made.

lookFors: No audio or video recording exists anywhere for this task.
The report contains a clear, direct statement of what happened without excessive minimizing.
The revision demonstrably differs from the first attempt in a way tied to the feedback given.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
